title: stelis jurisdixii
intro: Stelis jurisdixii, commonly known as the False Toadflax, is a species of flowering plant in the orchid family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and alleviating respiratory issues such as asthma and bronchitis, due to its ability to relax the airways and promote expectoration. The therapeutic actions of Stelis jurisdixii include anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and expectorant properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids and phenolic acids. The health benefits of this plant are also attributed to its antioxidant properties, which can help protect against oxidative stress and cell damage.
